title: I was doing (past continuous)
summary: Past continuous (**was / were + -ing**) — действие, которое **было в процессе** в определённый момент прошлого: «я как раз делал ...».
ru:
## Когда используем
Past continuous описывает действие, **которое шло (продолжалось) в определённый момент в прошлом**. Вспомните вопрос «Что ты делал в 8 вечера?» — «Я смотрел фильм».
> At 4 o'clock Sarah **was playing** tennis. — В 4 часа Сара играла в теннис.
> What **were** you **doing** at 11.30 yesterday? — Что ты делал вчера в 11.30?
> In 1985 we **were living** in Canada. — В 1985 году мы жили в Канаде.
Важно: мы не говорим, когда действие началось и закончилось — просто **оно шло** в тот момент.

## Как образуется
**was / were + глагол с -ing**
- **was** — I / he / she / it
- **were** — we / you / they
> I **was working**. They **were watching** TV. It **was raining**.
Отрицание: **wasn't / weren't + -ing**
> I **wasn't listening**. — Я не слушал.
> It **wasn't raining** when we went out. — Дождя не было, когда мы вышли.
Вопрос: **Was / Were + подлежащее + -ing?**
> **Were** you **working**? — Ты работал?
> What **were** you **doing**? — Что ты делал?

## Сравните с настоящим
> I'**m working** (now). → I **was working** at 10.30 last night.
> What **are** you **doing**? → What **were** you **doing** at three o'clock?

## Правила написания -ing
Те же, что в unit 3: live → living, run → running, lie → lying.

## Слова-подсказки
**at 8 o'clock yesterday, at that time, this time last week, all morning**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I was work at 8.~~ → I **was working** at 8.
- ~~We was watching TV.~~ → We **were** watching TV.
- ~~They was playing.~~ → They **were** playing.
- ~~Did you working?~~ → **Were** you working?
- ~~He was comeing.~~ → He was **coming**.
en:
## When do we use it?
We use the past continuous for an action that **was in progress at a certain time in the past**.
> At 4 o'clock Sarah **was playing** tennis.
> What **were** you **doing** at 11.30 yesterday?
> In 1985 we **were living** in Canada.
We are not saying when the action started or finished — only that it **was happening** at that time.

## How to make it
**was / were + verb-ing**
- **was** — I / he / she / it
- **were** — we / you / they
> I **was working**. They **were watching** TV. It **was raining**.
Negative: **wasn't / weren't + -ing**
> I **wasn't listening**.
> It **wasn't raining** when we went out.
Question: **Was / Were + subject + -ing?**
> **Were** you **working**?
> What **were** you **doing**?

## Compare with the present
> I'**m working** (now). → I **was working** at 10.30 last night.
> What **are** you **doing**? → What **were** you **doing** at three o'clock?

## Time expressions
**at 8 o'clock yesterday, at that time, this time last week, all morning**

## Common mistakes
- ~~I was work at 8.~~ → I **was working** at 8.
- ~~We was watching TV.~~ → We **were** watching TV.
- ~~Did you working?~~ → **Were** you working?
structure:
## Утверждение, отрицание, вопрос
| Подлежащее | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | I was working | I wasn't working | Was I working? |
| he / she / it | she was working | she wasn't working | Was she working? |
| we / you / they | they were working | they weren't working | Were they working? |

## Формулы
> Подлежащее + **was / were** + глагол**-ing**
> Подлежащее + **wasn't / weren't** + глагол**-ing**
> (Слово) + **Was / Were** + подлежащее + глагол**-ing**?

## Краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Да | Нет |
|---|---|---|
| Was I / he / she / it ...-ing? | Yes, I / he / she / it **was**. | No, I / he / she / it **wasn't**. |
| Were we / you / they ...-ing? | Yes, we / you / they **were**. | No, we / you / they **weren't**. |

## Present continuous → Past continuous
| Present | Past |
|---|---|
| am / is + -ing | **was** + -ing |
| are + -ing | **were** + -ing |

## Правила -ing
- + ing: work → working
- -e → убираем e: live → living
- удвоение: run → running, sit → sitting
- lie → lying

## Слова времени
**at 8 o'clock yesterday, at that time, this time last week, all day, while**

exercises.title: Где они были и что делали?
exercises.instruction: Вчера в 3 часа дня. Поставьте глагол в past continuous.

items.text: Ann was at home. She {{was watching}} TV.
Carol and Jack were at the cinema. They {{were watching}} a film.
Tom was in his car. He {{was driving}}.
Catherine was at the station. She {{was waiting}} for a train.
Mr and Mrs Hall were in the park. They {{were walking}}.
I was at school. I {{was writing}} a test.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите о том, что вы делали в определённое время. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Что вы делали вчера в 8 часов вечера?
items.sample: At 8 o'clock yesterday I was watching a film.

items.prompt: Что вы делали в 7 утра сегодня?
items.sample: At 7 this morning I was having breakfast.

items.prompt: Что вы делали вчера в полдень?
items.sample: At noon yesterday I was working.
In 2015 I was living in Bishkek.

items.prompt: Что вы НЕ делали вчера в 10 вечера?
items.sample: At 10 last night I wasn't sleeping.
